chinese: 民不畏死，奈何以死惧之？
若使民常畏死，而为奇者，吾得执而杀之，孰敢？
常有司杀者杀，夫代司杀者杀，是谓代大匠斲。
夫代大匠斲者，希有不伤其手矣。
pinyin: Mín bù wèi sǐ， nài hé yǐ sǐ jù zhī？
Ruò shǐ mín cháng wèi sǐ， ér wèi qí zhě， wú dé zhí ér shā zhī， shú gǎn？
Cháng yǒu sī shā zhě shā， fū dài sī shā zhě shā， shì wèi dài dà jiàng zhuó。
Fū dài dà jiàng zhuó zhě， xī yǒu bù shāng qí shǒu yǐ。
english: If you do not fear death, then how can it intimidate you? If you aren't afraid of dying, there is nothing you can not do.
Those who harm others are like inexperienced boys trying to take the place of a great lumberjack. Trying to fill his shoes will only get them seriously hurt.
